+'use strict'
+
+const assert = require('node:assert')
+const Fastify = require('../fastify')
+
+async function run () {
+  const fastify = Fastify()
+
+  fastify.addContentTypeParser('application/custom-string', { parseAs: 'string' }, function (req, body, done) {
+    throw new Error('kaboom string')
+  })
+
+  fastify.addContentTypeParser('application/custom-stream', function (req, payload, done) {
+    throw new Error('kaboom stream')
+  })
+
+  fastify.post('/string', (req, reply) => {

+
+  const res1 = await fastify.inject({
+    method: 'POST',

+  const res2 = await fastify.inject({

+    url: '/stream',

+    payload: 'hello'
+  })
